name: Death Domain
summary: Clerics of death gods who wield necrotic power (DM option for villains).

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: You gain proficiency with martial weapons.

features.name: Reaper
features.short: Learn a necromancy cantrip; single-target ones can hit two creatures.
features.summary: You learn one necromancy cantrip of your choice from any class. When you cast a necromancy cantrip that targets one creature, it can target two creatures within range and 5 ft. of each other.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.short: Melee hit deals extra 5 + 2 x level necrotic.
features.summary: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use Channel Divinity to deal extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction
features.summary: Necrotic damage dealt by your cleric spells and Channel Divinity ignores resistance to necrotic damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Improved Reaper
features.short: Single-target necromancy spells (1st-5th) can hit two creatures.
features.summary: When you cast a necromancy spell of 1st through 5th level that targets one creature, it can target two creatures within range and 5 ft. of each other.

notes: Dungeon Master's Guide villain option; ask your DM.
